sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Today, you will strike a great balance between your professional and personal life, predicts Ganesha. You will save your money from being swindled by others. You may be lagging in the race to catch up with your goals, but will not be disappointed by what you achieve. It is an auspicious day to undertake business deals and start new projects, feels Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Communicate from a centered space today, Taurus. Fortunately, the nature of the day caters to your needs and desires. You shouldn't have to work too hard to get what you want. Things should come to you naturally. You may wonder why you got stressed out before over what now seem to be small issues. Consciously release the worry and concern that are still stored in your body.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Wins come on suddenly while the Aquarius Moon aspects Pluto and Uranus, darling Taurus, putting your finances and career on an upswing. Don't dim your light simply because others aren't capable of celebrating your successes. Saturn activates midafternoon to help you enforce boundaries that will protect your happiness and alleviate unwarranted guilt. Now is also a good time to plot next moves, ensuring recent milestones don't lead to dead ends. Be mindful of how new responsibilities impact your stress levels and emotions when Luna opposes Mars this evening.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Try to get out of your office early for some recreation. Today, some unemployed natives of this sign can get jobs, which will improve their financial condition. Friends and relatives will demand more attention but this is the perfect time to close the doors to the world and treat yourself royally. Associate with people who are established and can give you insight into future trends. Excellent day for social as well as religious functions. Relatives of your spouse might disturb the harmony of your marital bliss.
